description: This file defines an abstract class 'XGradientBrush' in the PdfSharp.Drawing namespace, which represents a linear gradient brush used for drawing gradients in PDF graphics. It includes properties to extend the gradient beyond its bounds and handles different platform-specific using directives.

classes.name: XGradientBrush
classes.description: An abstract class representing a linear gradient brush with properties to control whether the gradient extends beyond its bounds.

methods.name: ExtendLeft
methods.description: Getter and setter for the flag indicating whether the gradient should extend left beyond its bounds.

methods.name: ExtendRight
methods.description: Getter and setter for the flag indicating whether the gradient should extend right beyond its bounds.
